title: DDA Reduces Pending Complaints by 85% in Six Months
summary: The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) has reduced pending complaints by 85% over six months, from 22,946 to 3,167. The number of complaints received during January-June was around 20,000. The DDA claims that it has resolved 19,779 complaints and reduced the number of pending cases by 85%. The government had set a target to reduce the number of pending complaints. The opposition alleged that the government's efforts were insufficient to address the issue. The police claimed that they have been working closely with the DDA to resolve the complaints.
summary_points: The DDA has reduced pending complaints by 85% over six months, from 22,946 to 3,167.
